title: a market is a set of towns, and the zip decides which one a person is in

criteria.text: A market is a row of whole counties and split-county subdivisions; every other county is its own waiting market; moving one is one row; may cross states
criteria.note: [V] `markets`, `market_members`, `market_key()` (#693, PR #708, review-skipped, deploy-health green on 4431c25). Checked: yes, `tests/f103-markets-db.test.ts` marked F103.1 (#850, PR #910, green on 82a9edc): Sacramento's counties and the Tahoe carve-outs, every US county in exactly one market, one row moves a county, and a Nevada county joins Tahoe; seen failing against a market_key that ignores out-of-state members. #907 (2026-10-18) adds F076's check that every US zip and county resolves to one market

criteria.text: A zip resolves to exactly one market the same way every time (zip to county to market; subdivision inside a split county); unknown zip refused with the exact words
criteria.note: [V] `zip_county`, `zip_market_key`, refusal "We don't recognize that zip, try again." (#694, PR #709, review-skipped, green on 4f571f5); Connecticut's planning regions added by #959 (green on 4f691c0). Checked: yes for this row, `tests/f103-markets-db.test.ts` marked F103.2 partial (#850): zip → county → market, the subdivision decides inside split Placer, one county per zip, same answer every time, unknown zip refused; seen failing against a lookup that ignores the subdivision. The marker is partial only for the source (row 2b, #849)

criteria.text: The zip-to-county source is the HUD-USPS crosswalk, largest residential share wins
criteria.note: [V] stand-in: Census 2020 ZCTA files, largest land area, 10,174 zips flagged `guess`; PO-box-only zips unknown (#694 PR body, #693 comment; scripts/generate-zip-county-migration.ts). HUD token not registered; #849 open with the PM (needs-pm), no comment since filing

criteria.text: The zip decides, nobody picks: open market signs in, waiting market joins that waitlist and is named; no IP, GPS, default, shortlist or picker
criteria.note: [V] Checked: yes, `tests/signup-zip-market-db.test.tsx` marked F103.3 (#850, PR #910): an open zip signs the person in and names the market, a waiting zip names its market and joins that waitlist, nothing to pick, and a scan finds no IP, position or default on the signup path; seen failing against a default market. The zip step is reached only through the profile screen, which the live sign-in skips since #946 (F081.1, #847). Explore's visitor fallback is F104/F105 (#588), not sign-up

criteria.text: Nothing member-facing reads the MSA or CSA; no surface shows MSA, CSA or metro
criteria.note: [V] built half (#895, review-skipped, deploy-health green on 4b9558a): the Default metro row is gone from /you and src/lib/copy-no-metro-words.test.ts scans member-facing .tsx prose for metro, MSA and CSA. Missing: three routed screens still say metro and are allow-listed in that guard (AreaPicker 'this metro', MetroNotCoveredPanel 'this metro opens', MetroWaitlistStep 'Pick your metro'; RecruitmentGrid's CSA is the farm box), and member-facing reads of the MSA remain: explore/actions.ts reads metro_polygons, location-actions.ts, /api/boundaries and neighborhood-search.ts filter places by msa_code (grep 2026-10-23). #848 was closed on #895 with those named as left open; the strings wait on F105's place control and a word from Don

criteria.text: A member in an open market has a home town (Place their zip mostly lies in, else county remainder), re-resolved when the zip changes, private
criteria.note: [V] `members.home_town`, `zip_home()`, `member.zip.set` (#695, PR #757, review-skipped, green on e0f16a9). Checked: yes for this row, `tests/f103-markets-db.test.ts` marked F103.5 partial (#850): signup stores the Place, a zip in no Place gives the county remainder, each move re-resolves it, and no visitor or other member reads it by row, view, function or page; seen failing against a zip change that keeps the old town. The marker is partial only for the day-it-opens half (row 5b, #616)

criteria.text: A member in a waiting market gets a home town the day it opens
criteria.note: [V] `backfill_home_towns(market)` exists and is tested (`home-town-db.test`), and since #919 (2026-10-18) writes only as service_role; nothing calls it: no code opens a market (#616 comment names the call). Half built, so no
